projects.name: lsmkv
projects.description: An LSM-tree key-value storage engine in Rust with a checksummed write-ahead log and group commit, SSTables with bloom filters, leveled compaction and MVCC snapshots. A simulated filesystem crashes it at every I/O operation to prove recovery.
highlights: CRC-32C-checked WAL with group commit: one record and one fsync per group of writers.
SSTables with prefix compression and bloom filters at 10 bits per key; leveled compaction with snapshot-aware version dropping.
Crash-tested at every single I/O operation through a simulated filesystem.

projects.name: replayagent
projects.description: A single-node durable execution runtime for LLM agents, in the style of Temporal. Every LLM and tool call is an activity recorded in an event-sourced SQLite history, so a new worker can replay the workflow after a crash and run only the unfinished work.
highlights: Zero runtime dependencies: standard library only (sqlite3, threading, urllib).
Deterministic replay with a determinism checker that parks a workflow as blocked instead of corrupting it.
Retries with exponential backoff and jitter, durable timers and human-in-the-loop signals.

projects.name: syncboard
projects.description: A local-first collaborative kanban board. Offline edits persist in IndexedDB and sync through a WebSocket relay, and Yjs CRDTs merge concurrent edits deterministically across network partitions.
highlights: Concurrent edits converge on every replica instead of being overwritten, including after a split-brain.
32 unit and conflict-resolution tests plus a Playwright offline/online end-to-end test.
Live multi-user cursors via Yjs awareness and a Dockerized relay.

projects.name: ratevault
projects.description: A motor insurance quote engine with bitemporal rate tables, so any past quote can be repriced to the penny using the rates in force at the time. It includes a live browser demo.
highlights: Rate rows carry valid-time and transaction-time ranges and are closed, never updated or deleted; a database trigger rejects overlapping ranges.
Demo: a quote of GBP 1995.19 stays provable while the backdated-correction answer is GBP 1671.64.
Deterministic pure pricing function and idempotent quote issuance; twelve tests run in CI.

projects.name: permitflow
projects.description: A municipal permitting workflow where a declared statechart compiles into database constraints and triggers, so illegal status transitions are rejected by the database itself, even for raw SQL.
highlights: One statechart with 11 states and 15 declared transitions drives both enforcement and citizen-facing next-step text.
Demo swept all 95 illegal pairs: 95 rejected, 0 accepted.
Append-only history; triggers block rewrites and any move out of a terminal state.

projects.name: pickpath
projects.description: An offline-first warehouse picking sync core where conflicting picks become supervisor exception tasks instead of silently lost picks. A reservation ledger validates offline actions rather than merging them.
highlights: On 500 contested SKUs the reservation ledger had 0 silent losses; the last-write-wins baseline had 500.
Idempotent apply keyed by (pickerId, clientSeq): 1000 duplicate submissions recognised with the outcome unchanged.
Seeded partition simulator makes silent losses a measured count.

projects.name: rotationchaos
projects.description: A workload-identity lab that issues SPIFFE-style certificates with 60-second lifetimes and injects rotation failures such as CA outage and clock skew, so the rotation path is exercised constantly and every failure is asserted to fail closed.
highlights: Nine scenarios (one steady state, eight failures), each with its expected denial reason written down; all fail-closed scenarios held.
Steady state: 50,000 requests, 1,666 rotations, 0 failures.
A fail-open detector flags any request allowed after denial has begun; 15 tests, standard library only.

projects.name: provenance-gate
projects.description: A SLSA provenance verifier that checks attestations against policy, then rebuilds the artifact and diffs it to prove the binary came from the reviewed source instead of trusting the attestation.
highlights: Rejects with specific reason codes such as DIGEST_MISMATCH, WRONG_BUILDER, REPLAYED and NOT_REPRODUCIBLE.
A compromised runner with a validly signed attestation is caught only by the rebuild-and-diff step.
19 tests; Python standard library only, with a browser demo.

projects.name: reachable
projects.description: A CVE triage tool that checks static call-graph reachability from application entry points to the vulnerable function. It returns reachable, not-reachable or indeterminate, and never a silent "safe".
highlights: Dynamic dispatch such as getattr or eval makes any "not reached" result indeterminate instead of dropping it.
Demo: of 8 advisories, 2 reachable, 1 indeterminate and 5 not reachable; one added getattr() shifts the result to 6 indeterminate.
CI gate and SARIF 2.1.0 output; built on the standard-library ast module.
